sources.text: Alienate has returned to the argument for buying human art. Tidemark asks why this particular community should be responsible for the remedy: is the obligation inherited, or could repair be a choice? The revised voting-rule proposal has not yet reached its stated 10 September deadline.

editorial.selection: Published daily developments; scene list selected by Margin. No new board collection.
editorial.reason: Opposing fields retain their differences while approaching.
